subject.title: fix: open selected channel setup immediately

question: Should this PR retain the broad exact-owner and Gateway lifecycle protocol work as part of the `channels add` direct-entry fix, or should the user-visible CLI fix be narrowed and the ownership contract be reviewed separately?
rationale: Both paths are technically plausible, but the repository’s compatibility-sensitive channel, plugin, and Gateway boundaries require maintainer intent on whether the collision hardening is part of the intended product contract.

options.title: Review the coupled invariant
options.body: Keep the direct-entry and owner-validation work together if exact channel ownership must be preserved consistently across setup, routing, bindings, logs, and lifecycle operations.

options.title: Split the protocol scope
options.body: Land a narrow direct-entry change and move the lifecycle ownership metadata plus broad collision normalization into a separately scoped compatibility review.

recommendation.title: Review the coupled invariant
recommendation.body: Keep the direct-entry and owner-validation work together if exact channel ownership must be preserved consistently across setup, routing, bindings, logs, and lifecycle operations.
